learned A.G.A. for the State.

The instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking quashing of the charge-sheet dated 23.12.2022 and entire proceedings in Case No. 28582 of 2022 (State of U.P. vs.
Mohseen and Others), arising out of Case Crime No.58 of 2022 u/S 498A, 323, 354, 354-ka, 504,
506 I.P.C., Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Section 3/4 Muslim Women (Protection of Marriage) Act, 2019,
P.S.- Jani, District- Meerut, pending in the court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.1,
Meerut.
3.

sentences.text:
Learned counsels for the applicants further submits that in terms of the said order dated 16.11.2023, parties have appeared before the trial court for verification of the compromise dated 04.11.2023, whereby the parties have agreed to dissolve their marriage and the applicant no.1 had paid the sum of Rs.
3,10,000/- towards all claims of maintenance and Iddat etc., to the opposite party no.2 and parties have agreed to withdraw all cases against each other.
The said compromise has been verified by the trial court on 23.11.2023, in presence of the parties, certified copy of the same has been annexed as Annexure '5' to the instant application.

Therefore, learned counsel for the applicants submits that since it was a matrimonial dispute between the applicant no.1 and the opposite party no.2, due to which the instant case was registered against the applicants herein and the parties have settled their matrimonial dispute amicably and executed a compromise on 04.11.2023, which has been duly verified by the concerned trial court, vide order dated 23.11.2023.
Therefore, he has prayed for quashing of the entire proceedings of the instant case, on the basis of compromise between the parties.
4. Learned A.G.A for State do not dispute the factum of compromise, which has been duly verified by the trial court.
In view thereof, we do not oppose the quashing of the entire proceedings of this case on the basis of the compromise as it was a matrimonial dispute between the parties.
5. Having heard the submissions made by learned counsels for the parties, this Court has carefully gone through the record of the case.

From the record of the case, it is apparent that it was a matrimonial dispute between the parties, which has been duly settled and compromise dated 04.11.2023 was executed between the parties, vide order dated 16.11.2023, this court has directed the parties to get the said compromise verified through the concerned trial court.
In terms of the aforesaid dated 16.11.2023, the parties have appeared before the trial court and got the said verified in presence of the parties on 23.11.2023.

In such circumstances, since it was a matrimonial dispute,
which has been settled and the parties have agreed to dissolve their marriage and withdraw all cases against each other and full and final settlement amount has already been paid by the applicant no.1 to the opposite party no.2 6.

In view thereof, the instant application is allowed and the entire proceedings in Case No. 28582 of 2022 (State of U.P. vs. Mohseen and Others), arising out of Case Crime No.58 of 2022 u/S 498A,
323, 354, 354-ka, 504, 506 I.P.C., Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Section 3/4 Muslim Women (Protection of Marriage) Act, 2019, P.S.- Jani, District- Meerut, pending in the court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.1, Meerut, are hereby quashed.
